target_customer: Plus-size women (sizes 10 to 28) who want minimalist everyday essentials
problem: Plus-size women had few well-made, simple, affordable wardrobe staples; the founder said the brand grew from wanting clothes her mother could wear.

founders.name: Karine Hsu
prior_employers: A financial firm in San Francisco (unnamed in the source)
founders.background_notes: Yahoo Lifestyle (2018-04-24) says she worked with several plus-size fashion brands at a financial firm. The YC page does not list her; it lists only Jeffrey Zhao.

founders.name: Jeffrey Zhao
previous_startups: Ordinal (tryordinal.com, social media content platform, per YC profile)
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in the Yahoo launch article and the only founder on the YC page.

exit.reason: No public statement found; YC marks the company Inactive.

competitors.name: Universal Standard
competitors.what: Plus-size and size-inclusive luxury everyday essentials brand

competitors.name: Premme
competitors.what: Trend-driven, affordable plus-size line by bloggers Nicolette Mason and Gabi Gregg, launched in 2017

technical_complexity.rationale: A Shopify-style direct-to-consumer apparel store; the hard parts were sourcing, fit testing on 18 women of varied sizes and inventory, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Apparel design and a small four-piece collection are easy to copy, and Universal Standard and Premme already addressed adjacent positioning.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; Premme ceased production in July 2019 according to a fashion trade summary.

market_need_then: Plus-size apparel was widely discussed as underserved, with new size-inclusive brands launching in 2017 and 2018, though sources found show launch coverage rather than sales data.

branding.domain_note: andcomfort.com returned an HTTP 522 error when fetched; no domain history found.

identity.visual_style: Minimalist, clean lines, quality fabrics such as organic cotton poplin and pima cotton
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and inclusive, centered on comfort and sizing 10 to 28

branding.brand_signature: Four launch pieces including a Cloud Cotton Tee and an Apron Dress
branding.community_and_virality: Launch coverage appeared on Yahoo Lifestyle and in plus-size fashion blogs in April 2018; no evidence of fan community or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Brief launch press in 2018 but no sign of a lasting community; the name is a common phrase and a trademark record under CurvyCo Inc. is listed as dead.

outcome_analysis: The cause of the shutdown is not public. The brand launched publicly on April 24, 2018 with four pieces and received launch press, and was later marked Inactive by YC. A third-party page offered a reason about niche focus and costly ethical materials but it reads as generated commentary and is not used. No failure factor is assigned without a source for the cause.
notes: The YC page lists only Jeffrey Zhao; the launch article names Karine Hsu as founder and CEO and Zhao as creative director and co-founder. The funding entry rests on a single database (CB Insights) and matches the standard YC investment amount, with a July 2018 date that does not match the Summer 2017 batch, so treat the date and its nature with caution. Competitor sources are from the April 2018 launch coverage, about ten months after the batch, because the company launched publicly then and no earlier dated source was found. The andcomfort.com fetch failed with HTTP 522 so the site status is unknown.
